figurative_meaning_en: Seeing all living beings as equal to oneself
similar_in_english: Put yourself in someone else's shoes
The Golden Rule: Treat others as you would like to be treated
example_sentences_in_bangla: তার জীবনদর্শন আত্মবৎ সর্বভূতেষু, তাই সে সকল প্রাণীর প্রতি সমদর্শিতা করে।
যোগীরা আত্মবৎ সর্বভূতেষু জ্ঞান করে সকলের প্রতি করুণা দেখান।
example_sentences_in_english: His philosophy embodies seeing all beings as one's own self, so he shows equality to everyone.
Yogis who perceive all creatures as their self exhibit compassion towards all.
history: This idiom originates from the Bhagavad Gita (Chapter 6, Verse 32), a key Hindu scripture, emphasizing equanimity and self-realization in the philosophy of Yoga.
note: Derived from Sanskrit, commonly used in religious and philosophical contexts in Bengali literature and discourse.
